title: MST Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq a_i < b_i \leq N; 1 \leq u_i < v_i \leq N; 1 \leq c_i, w_i \leq 10; The graph is connected before processing the queries.; All input values are integers.
